objective: Evaluate reusable improvements to Define so every required concept can carry an explicit subject, goal, operational use, concrete use cases, boundary, owner route, and unresolved questions without importing consumer-owned domain meaning.

observed_gaps.gap: Define records package-level goal and context but does not require an explicit subject, goal, operational role, and concrete use cases for every required concept.
observed_gaps.consequence: A concept can be dispositioned without proving what object it describes, why it exists, or how the named consumer will use it.

observed_gaps.gap: The current RPOS adapter reduces open questions to concept identifiers even though the project-owned Definition Pack carries question text and owner routes.
observed_gaps.consequence: The consumer boundary preserves openness but loses the actionable question and decision route.

observed_gaps.gap: The adapter validates source digests and concept coverage but does not inspect whether a bound validation receipt describes the same material digests and counts.
observed_gaps.consequence: An internally stale receipt can remain byte-current and pass the adapter's outer digest check.

observed_gaps.gap: Define has no explicit cross-concept distinction check for similarly named state concepts scoped to project, portfolio, and technical runtime subjects.
observed_gaps.consequence: A consumer can preserve individual definitions yet still collapse their subjects during handoff.

observed_gaps.gap: Definition Pack concepts have no explicit semantic dependency surface for internal definitions or exact external definitions.
observed_gaps.consequence: A concept may validate while silently depending on an undefined term, an unversioned donor meaning, or a specialization whose predecessor cannot be reproduced.

observed_gaps.gap: Define does not preserve whether a concept requires a formal expression, is intentionally governed by structured invariants, or remains formally open.
observed_gaps.consequence: A null formal expression can hide missing machine-relevant semantics, while human role concepts can be forced into artificial mathematics.

observed_gaps.gap: External semantic foundations are commonly validated by live repository path instead of a frozen digest-bound local snapshot.
observed_gaps.consequence: Consumers remain coupled to donor checkout layout and currentness and cannot reproduce validation independently.

proposed_successor_capabilities: Add a reusable concept-reasoning surface with subject, goal, operational interpretation, use cases, boundary, owner route, sources, and open questions.
Preserve structured open-question text and owner routes across consumer adapters.
Validate the internal material bindings and counts of any receipt used as current package evidence.
Add distinction fixtures that reject project-state, portfolio-state, and runtime-state collapse.
Add exact semantic dependency bindings with relation, version, digest, lifecycle posture, and closure validation.
Preserve formal-expression, structured-invariants, and open formalization postures plus their semantic tests.
Support portable external foundation snapshots without transferring ownership or admission.
Use RPOS as one external consumer fixture while keeping all RPOS meanings project-owned.
acceptance_checks: Existing Definition Packs remain readable or have an explicit successor migration.
Every required concept either carries the reasoning surface or declares a typed open gap.
Open questions retain question text, concept identity, and owner route.
A stale inner receipt fails even when the receipt file digest is pinned.
Missing, stale, or unversioned semantic dependencies fail closure validation.
Formalization posture and semantic tests survive the consumer adapter.
The package validates from a local foundation snapshot when the donor repository is absent.
No Define validation result promotes external definitions or authorizes construction.
non_goals: Do not import or own RPOS domain definitions.
Do not create or admit a ConstructionBinding.
Do not mutate Craft, AlchLang, ontology runtime, or ARE.
Do not promote the Define parent package or clear unrelated source drift.
open_questions: Should the reasoning surface be mandatory in the next Definition Pack schema or introduced as a compatible profile?
Should distinction checks live in Define core or in consumer-specific profiles?
Which receipt schema should Define recognize for transitive material verification?
Should portable foundation snapshots be part of Define or a separately governed semantic-foundation export contract?
Which concept classes require formal expressions versus explicit structured invariants?
claim_ceiling: Candidate semantic-improvement handoff only. It does not change Define, promote definitions, admit construction, establish conformance, or authorize implementation, publication, release, deployment, or external action.
